comment: Genuine full FDVD.  With current dunecore, the detector Name 'dunevd10kt_3view_30deg_v6_refactored' (contains 'dunevd10kt', NOT '1x8x'/'1x6x') makes DUNEWireReadout select CRPWireReadoutGeom -> bridged/wrapped induction.  2 CRM = 1 CRU = one 2-face WCT anode (pair-tpc).  Reproduces dune10kt-vd/dunevd10kt_3view_30deg_v6_refactored.json.bz2 (491520 channels).  CRPWireReadoutGeom also requires a PDMapTool (irrelevant to wires).
